title: CurateAi
tagline: Curate AI: Decentralized content platform with AI fraud prevention, fair voting & token rewards.
description:
Curate AI is a decentralized content-sharing platform designed to empower creators and curators while addressing the flaws of centralized and current Web3 alternatives. Centralized platforms face censorship, algorithmic bias, and opaque monetization, whereas decentralized platforms often struggle with whale dominance, vote circles, spam, and high onboarding friction. Curate AI solves these challenges through a dual-curation cycle: creators publish content → community members vote daily using their tokens → new tokens are minted and distributed proportionally to the votes received. To ensure fairness, an AI agent—holding 50% of the token supply—casts votes based on content quality, originality, and engagement, providing visibility for creators without large vote circles and reducing manipulation. Features like free claps and prepaid onboarding make participation accessible, while the primary focus is to keep interaction seamless: users only need blockchain knowledge when withdrawing their earnings.

To maintain decentralization in AI, Curate AI leverages the ASI Alliance stack. uAgents autonomously evaluate content, moderate posts, and participate in voting, while deployment on Agentverse ensures discovery, orchestration, and coordination across a decentralized network. The Fetch Network secures messaging, identities, and execution, and ASI:One allows users to interact directly with agents in natural language, making content evaluation and rating simple and intuitive. MeTTa provides structured reasoning to detect spam, abuse, and fraudulent activity, giving AI votes explainable, verifiable logic. This combination enables a system where human–agent collaboration drives fairness, transparency, and trust in content curation.

All content is stored publicly and verifiably on Filecoin using the Synapse SDK, ensuring permanence, auditability, and censorship resistance. The platform pre-pays storage costs, removing financial and technical barriers for creators while guaranteeing that posts remain immutable and retrievable. This Filecoin-backed foundation also supports future extensions, including verifiable AI-training datasets, decentralized archives, and other applications that benefit from durable, public content storage.

By combining seamless human–agent interaction, decentralized AI reasoning, transparent tokenomics, community-driven curation, and verifiable content storage, Curate AI creates a scalable, fair, and user-friendly ecosystem for creators, readers, and curators, redefining content creation in the decentralized era.
how_its_made:
Curate AI is built using a combination of blockchain, AI, and modern web technologies to deliver a seamless decentralized content experience. The smart contracts are written in Solidity, handling token distribution, staking, and voting, and are optimized by removing loops for calculating and dividing rewards, ensuring gas efficiency even at scale. Posts are stored on IPFS for immutability and decentralization, while a PostgreSQL database is used in parallel to make content retrieval fast and convenient. Comments and claps are handled off-chain, allowing users without blockchain accounts to interact freely without affecting token-based rewards.

For user onboarding, we integrated Magic Link, allowing creators and voters to sign in using Google authentication, removing friction for non-technical users. Blockchain transactions are queued using Redis, which ensures database consistency while processing transactions asynchronously. The AI scoring system is powered by ASI agents deployed on Agentverse, and the final content score is calculated as a weighted average between the overall score provided by the ASI chatbot and the evaluation from other tools like MeTTa. This approach ensures consistent, reliable, and fair content evaluation, minimizing bias and erratic fluctuations.

The project also integrates the Synapse SDK to store content on Filecoin, prepaying storage to remove cost barriers for creators while ensuring permanence, auditability, and censorship resistance. Overall, Curate AI combines optimized smart contracts, off-chain efficiency, decentralized storage, and autonomous AI agents to create a fair, seamless, and scalable content ecosystem.
